name: Audioscrape
description: Audioscrape gives Claude ears. Search millions of hours of transcribed spoken audio - podcasts, city-council and county meetings, and audio you upload - and get answers with speaker attribution, exact timestamps, and links that jump to the moment it was said. Explore a knowledge graph of people, companies, and topics extracted from what was actually said, follow entities across every recording, and upload your own audio for private, searchable, speaker-attributed transcripts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Audioscrape to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Audioscrape to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.audioscrape.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Audioscrape MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Audioscrape lists 19 MCP tools, including create_share_link, fetch, get_charts, get_entity_graph, get_episode_overview, get_speaker, get_transcript, get_transcription_status, get_trending, list_my_datasets, list_my_uploads, and list_podcast_episodes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Audioscrape?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Audioscrape in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Audioscrape requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Audioscrape is developed by Audioscrape Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
